description: Static weights of STANDARD v1.2.0 section 8.3. Evidence with a source type only weighs the source type's weight; from an item whose sender's identity has a trust class, with no source type, the class weight; with both, the lower of the two. Evidence with neither, with a source type that has no weight, or with a trust class the model does not have has no static weight, and an implementation refuses it (expect_error). A domain profile's trust_weights override weights: trust_class:<class> replaces a class weight, kept apart from a source key of the same name; any other key replaces the weight of the source type it names, higher or lower, or gives a weight to one the model does not name; with several profiles (profile_trust_weights given as a list), the lowest weight per key applies. `model` holds the weights of schemas/authority_trust_model.yaml that the vectors read. Normative (section 10.3). grounded_agency/trust.py is the reference implementation; tests/test_trust.py runs it against this file.

fields.name: The vector's name, unique in this file.
fields.source_type: The source type of the evidence. Absent: it has none.
fields.trust_class: The trust class of the identity of the item's sender. Absent: the evidence has none.
fields.profile_trust_weights: The trust_weights of the domain profile applied, or a list of those of several profiles applied together. Absent: no profile.
fields.weight: The expected static weight, absent when expect_error is true. A conforming value differs from it by at most `tolerance`.
fields.expect_error: true: the evidence has no static weight and an implementation refuses it; the vector then has no weight.

vectors.name: source_type_alone
vectors.about: Evidence with a source type and no trust class weighs the source weight.

vectors.name: trust_class_alone
vectors.about: Evidence with a trust class and no source type weighs the class weight.

vectors.name: class_lower_than_source
vectors.about: The lower of the two applies: a trusted channel cannot lift an untrusted sender.

vectors.name: source_lower_than_class
vectors.about: The lower of the two applies when the source weight is the lower one.

vectors.name: class_and_source_equal
vectors.about: Both weights are 0.55.

vectors.name: profile_overrides_a_class
vectors.about: The profile key trust_class:peer_agent replaces the class weight.

vectors.name: profile_overrides_a_source
vectors.about: The profile key primary_api replaces the source weight.

vectors.name: profile_names_its_own_source
vectors.about: The model has no weight for user_calendar; the profile gives it one, as the shipped profiles do for their own sources.

vectors.name: raised_class_still_bounded_by_source
vectors.about: The profile raises the class weight to 0.9; the source weight, 0.65, is now the lower.

vectors.name: lowered_class_bounds_the_source
vectors.about: The profile lowers the class weight to 0.4, below the source weight of 0.95.

vectors.name: source_key_does_not_override_the_class
vectors.about: system_of_record names a source type and a trust class. The profile key system_of_record is the source key: the class weight stays 0.92.

vectors.name: class_key_does_not_override_the_source
vectors.about: The profile key trust_class:system_of_record is the class key: the source weight stays 0.92.

vectors.name: both_keys_of_one_name
vectors.about: The profile overrides the source to 0.6 and the class to 0.8; the lower applies.

vectors.name: unrelated_profile_keys
vectors.about: Profile keys for other sources and classes change nothing.

vectors.name: profile_raises_a_source
vectors.about: A replacement may be higher than the model's weight: human_note, 0.55 in the model, weighs 0.9.

vectors.name: two_profiles_lowest
vectors.about: Two profiles applied together give primary_api 0.7 and 0.5: the lowest applies.

vectors.name: two_profiles_lowest_class
vectors.about: The lowest per key, a class key here; a profile without the key changes nothing for it.

vectors.name: unknown_source_type
vectors.about: A source type with no weight in the model or a profile has no static weight.

vectors.name: unknown_trust_class
vectors.about: A trust class the model does not have.

vectors.name: profile_key_adds_no_class
vectors.about: A profile key trust_class:<c> for a class the model does not have adds no class.

vectors.name: neither
vectors.about: Evidence with neither a source type nor a trust class.
